=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-RAW-HTML.md === # FEATURE: Raw HTML | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Preserves inline raw HTML tags and markup in rendered output. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md | | Provides | inline raw HTML | | Consumes | — | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Preserve valid inline HTML tags, comments, processing instructions, declarations, and CDATA sections as literal markup in HTML output. ## Behavior - Recognize the raw HTML forms defined by CommonMark 0.31.2 within inline content. - Preserve recognized markup verbatim, including tag names, attributes, whitespace, and line breaks. - Escape `<` and `>` when the input resembles markup but does not match a recognized raw HTML form. - Block HTML parsing is owned by `FEATURE-HTML-BLOCKS.md`. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC raw-html-conformance === Intent: All supplied Raw HTML examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Raw HTML"], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC raw-html-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-HARD-LINE-BREAKS.md === # FEATURE: Hard Line Breaks | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Parses hard line breaks within inline content. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md | | Provides | hard line breaks | | Consumes | — | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior - Render a line ending preceded by at least two spaces as `
` when it occurs within a block. - Render a backslash immediately before a line ending as `
` within a block. - Ignore leading spaces on the following line after a hard break. - Do not treat either form as a hard break at the end of a block or inside code spans or HTML tags. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC hard-line-breaks-conformance === Intent: All supplied Hard line breaks examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Hard line breaks"], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC hard-line-breaks-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT=== === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-SOFT-LINE-BREAKS.md === # FEATURE: Soft Line Breaks | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Preserves regular line endings between inline content. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md | | Provides | soft line breaks | | Consumes | — | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior - Parse a regular line ending not covered by hard-break rules as a soft line break. - Remove trailing spaces and leading spaces around soft line breaks. - Render soft line breaks as line endings in HTML, consistent with the supplied examples. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC soft-line-breaks-conformance === Intent: All supplied Soft line breaks examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Soft line breaks"], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC soft-line-breaks-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TEXTUAL-CONTENT.md === # FEATURE: Textual Content | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Preserves and safely renders plain textual content. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md | | Provides | textual content | | Consumes | — | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior - Preserve characters not assigned another CommonMark interpretation. - Escape text characters as required for safe HTML text output. - Preserve internal spaces verbatim. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC textual-content-conformance === Intent: All supplied Textual content examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Textual content"], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC textual-content-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT VERIFICATION.md === # FEATURE: Complete Conformance Verification | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Verifies the completed parser against the complete supplied conformance suite. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md | | Provides | complete CommonMark conformance verification | | Consumes | commonmark | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Run the sole terminal verification for CommonMark 0.31.2 after all parser stories are complete. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC full-commonmark-conformance === Intent: The supplied full conformance harness succeeds. Suite: full import subprocess result = subprocess.run( ["sh", "sources/full_test.sh"], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC full-commonmark-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Run only after all parser implementation stories have closed. - Do not modify or replace any supplied scoring asset. - The complete harness uses the root executable `./commonmark`. - Do not run this complete-suite check from implementation stories. === END ARTIFACT
